intent: Build C as editable native Blender artwork and test the silent heavy-box action
method: Blender 5.2 background Python; vector curves, keyed pose controls and native transform drivers
result: Source saved before first build; selected frames will be rendered and inspected

intent: Inspect the first editable character and action poses
method: Visual inspection of four rendered frames plus Blender integrity checks
result: Native drivers and source contacts pass. Opening arms cross; legs bend too strongly; mitten contact is only approximated by a wrist offset.
decision: Preserve this attempt; correct silhouettes and actual mitten-edge contact in v002

intent: Correct opening silhouette and pushing contact
method: Blender native curves with revised bend controls and mitten contour contact
result: Saved revised source; v001 retained

intent: Check corrected silhouettes and the transition from pushing to release
method: Visual inspection of five rendered poses and inspection of the animated hand trajectory
result: Silhouettes improved. Found a discontinuity after frame 151: release interpolation started from the old wrist location instead of the moving box contact.
decision: Preserve v002 and fix the contact-to-release transition before delivery

intent: Remove the hand snap at release and render the complete silent preview
method: Blender native animation with contact-derived release keys and a transition regression check
result: Third source version saved; earlier attempts preserved

intent: Verify the reopened editable project across all frames
method: Blender evaluated transforms and object bounding boxes
result: Framing check failed at frame 157. Diagnosis: Blender curve bounding boxes conservatively expand this narrow outline by one unit; visible geometry is not cropped.
decision: Replace bounding-box framing check with evaluated mesh vertices and rerun; preserve failed checker and log

intent: Verify the actual reopened editable artifact and encoded video
method: Blender 5.2 with auto-execution disabled; evaluated mesh geometry across 240 frames; FFprobe metadata and sequential frame count
result: All 240 frames pass contact, plant, attachment, release, framing and dependency checks. Video is 10 seconds, 24 fps, 720p, with no audio.
decision: Technical pass only; retain creative review separately

intent: Deliver a first silent acting proof using character C
method: Native Blender vectors and pose controls; local rendered frames encoded with FFmpeg; visual inspection of selected renders and frame sequences
result: A complete rough preview and editable character are saved. Earlier attempts and the failed verifier are retained. Timing polish, a recovery overlap and the targeted revision test remain.
decision: Ready for user playback review; no production-grade acceptance claimed

intent: Strengthen the second push and clear the recovery hand arc while preserving the opening and ending

result: User praised the first preview and authorized continuation. Planned revision window is frames 89–192; independently rendered frames 1–88 and 193–240 will be compared to v003.

intent: Check hand clearance throughout recovery, beyond the selected stills
method: Reopened Blender project; mitten contours evaluated in head coordinates over frames 154–179
result: Far-hand arc clears the head. The near-hand outline grazes the conservative head boundary at frames 170 and 171 (minimum normalized radius 0.9953).
decision: Preserve v004; move the near recovery hand slightly outward and rerun the same check

intent: Complete the stronger push and keep both recovery hands clear of the face
method: Same versioned pose tracks and Blender character; near hand moved outward during recovery
result: Saved corrected source; opening and ending remain protected against the original delivered v003 frames

intent: Prove the protected opening and ending are unchanged
method: Whole PNG-file byte comparison
result: All file bytes differed. PNG chunk inspection found changed embedded project paths, dates and render times; whole-file equality incorrectly includes this metadata.
decision: Preserve the failed checker; compare decoded pixel hashes while retaining complete-file hashes for artifact identity

intent: Verify the saved revision and protect unrelated frames
method: Reopened Blender project across 240 frames; expanded-head hand-clearance check; SHA-256 hashes of FFmpeg-decoded pixels; FFprobe metadata
result: 136 protected frames are pixel-identical to v003; 90 changed frames remain inside the revision window. Contacts, plants, release, framing and recovery hand clearance pass. Video is silent, 10 seconds, 24 fps.
decision: Bounded revision test achieved; creative preference remains for user review

intent: Deliver stronger second-push acting and clearer recovery
method: Versioned native Blender animation, independently rendered frames, FFmpeg preview and synchronized comparison excerpt
result: Deeper anticipation, short hold, faster drive and stronger effort expression; hands clear the head during recovery. Earlier attempts and failed checks are retained.
decision: Ready for playback review; different-action reuse test and final production polish remain future work

intent: Render the corrected color, lighting and synthesized sound version
